title: Cutler v. Platte Valley Presbytery
disposition_detail: The Standing Judicial Commission found Cutler's complaint administratively out of order. The report gives no reason or further relief.
first_summary: The SJC found Dale Cutler's complaint against Platte Valley Presbytery administratively out of order without explaining the basis for that ruling.
summary: Dale Cutler filed a complaint against Platte Valley Presbytery. The SJC found it administratively out of order, but the sparse report does not identify the challenged action, explain the procedural defect, or provide further relief. It therefore supports no conclusion about the complaint's merits.
